rationale: LINC has gapped up 13.5% on elevated relative volume and is now sitting at 97.5% of its intraday range near the session high, but the most recent 1-minute candle shows a small bearish close ($21.91) with a wide spread (109 bps) and declining volume — momentum is stalling at resistance. The active class-action lawsuit alleging fraudulent enrollment disclosures creates a fundamental overhang that makes the gap-up thesis unreliable for a long, while the stock's already-extended position above VWAP by ~4% and proximity to the high make a short entry risky without a clear rejection pattern. The combination of illiquidity (wide spread, small float), legal risk, and ambiguous near-term price action offers no clean edge in either direction.
